faq.q: What is a titanium socket head cap screw (iso 4762)?
faq.a: A titanium socket head cap screw (iso 4762) is a precision-machined fastener component used in socket head cap screw m5-m24. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What torque should I use for titanium socket head cap screw (iso 4762)?
faq.a: Recommended installation torque depends on thread size and lubrication. For M5 titanium fasteners: 4-5 Nm (dry), 3-4 Nm (with anti-seize). Always use titanium-compatible anti-seize compound to prevent galling (cold welding) of threads.

faq.q: How is titanium socket head cap screw (iso 4762) manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Socket Head Cap Screw (ISO 4762) is manufactured using Cold heading. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium socket head cap screw (iso 4762)?
faq.a: The most common issue is thread galling (cold welding) when titanium threads mate without anti-seize compound. Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
